newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Tamil separatists (LTTE) take radar equipment and fuel from North Korean merchant ship. The LTTE captured the ship and its North Korean crew of 38 off the northern Point Pedro coast on Monday. One crew member was killed in a shoot out with the rebels.

The eastern port city of Trincomalee was in mourning on Wednesday, as slain Tamil United Liberation Front (TULF) member, A. Thangathurai was burried. Thangathurai was killed in an attack allegedly carried out by the LTTE during the weekend.
A total of 28 government doctors who were appointed to embattled areas in the north and east, but did not report for work, will be sacked, says Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Health.
LTTE planned assassination of TULF Trincomalee district MP A. Thangathurai for three months, say police sources.
